meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'tsx debug', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'attach the debugger', 'debug it', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'reverse engineering', 'playwright'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并修复任意语言或二进制的运行时问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的隐蔽错误
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix runtime issues in any language or binary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix subtle bugs in code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按假设驱动循环调试：先形成至少3个假设，并行调查；若两轮失败，从不同角度生成“预言”来确认根因；用失败测试锁定问题，最小化修复，最后实际使用系统做质量检查并清理痕迹。
howto.when: 当你描述程序崩溃、静默失败、响应错误、进程卡住、内存泄漏、异步行为异常、时序问题，或要求逆向工程时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个 Python 脚本，它运行到一半就崩溃了。
为什么我的 Node.js 服务返回空响应？
say.note: Claude 会检查 Node 运行时参考，排查静默失败。

say.text: 这个 Go 程序有 goroutine 泄漏，帮我定位。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Go 运行时参考和 dlv 等工具。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a hypothesis-driven debug loop: forms ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, spawns Oracles after 2 failed rounds, confirms root cause with a failing test, fixes minimally, QA by actually using the system, and scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, hangs, memory leaks, async misbehavior, timing issues, or request reverse engineering.

say_en.text: Debug this Python script that crashes midway.
say_en.note: Claude reads the Python runtime reference and starts the loop.

say_en.text: Why is my Node.js service returning empty responses?
say_en.note: Claude checks Node runtime reference for silent failures.

say_en.text: This Go program has a goroutine leak, help me find it.
say_en.note: Claude uses Go runtime reference and tools like dlv.
